additional_info.subject: ID0446512-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/S0 170004173] Cooling issue in CCS2 cables. CRM:02889000525
additional_info.body:
Dear SiD expert’s
We have our Customer Dreier AG with an leak of cooling liquid. Yesterday we were on site and checked the system we faced a lot of parts which are covered by liquid drops, please have a look at the attached pictures.
The technicians identified an loosen screw. I don’t have any background information if this loosen screw could be the rootcause for the leckage, also in our documentation there is no details regarding this screw, can you tell us if this screw is necessary for a closed liquid system, can the leckage cause by this screw?
The technician said we would recommend to replace this “dispenser-block” where the screw where lossen and the 4 blue pipes are connected, but this block is not available as an sparepart so we have tp replace the complete cooling unit, which cost more that 10.000€.
I would appreciate your expert feedback regarding this case and what you would suggest.
Thanks in advance
Alex
Siemens Schweiz AG
Switzerland
Freilagerstrasse 28
8047 Zürich, Schweiz
